records.mechanical_separator: Round.mode is GENERATE until GENERATE_CLOSED; only emit_idea/pass are legal. score/cluster are CRITIQUE acts and cannot occupy a GENERATE turn.
records.leak_stop: Speech-act whitelist plus a frozen idea bag. Generators never receive the annotation store as context, so scores cannot suppress further emits.
records.idea_count_rule: Count = bag length at GENERATE_CLOSED. Critique writes annotations only; drop_idea is a leak.

records.mechanical_separator: Studio rounds are GENERATE (sketch). Pin-up is a distinct CRITIQUE round whose role is unbound until GENERATE_CLOSED.
records.leak_stop: pinup_critique is illegal while studio.mode=GENERATE. Idea count is sketches at the studio close, not survivors of pin-up.

records.mechanical_separator: Box fill and combination emit are GENERATE. Consistency screening is CRITIQUE and cannot mark a cell invalid during fill.
records.leak_stop: screen_combination is illegal before GENERATE_CLOSED. Screening cannot decrement the combination bag.
records.idea_count_rule: Count = combinations emitted before GENERATE_CLOSED, not post-screen survivors.

records.mechanical_separator: Inventive-principle application emits solutions (GENERATE). Dual-parameter scoring is CRITIQUE.
records.leak_stop: score_against_both_parameters cannot share a GENERATE turn with apply_principle. Feasibility scoring is not an input to later GENERATE turns.

records.mechanical_separator: Hat token IS the mode. Only green_hat_emit increments the idea bag. black_hat is CRITIQUE. white/red/yellow/blue are PROCESS and do not count.
records.leak_stop: black_hat speech acts are illegal under a green hat token. Idea count ignores black-hat kills.

records.mechanical_separator: GENERATE evaluates against C_relaxed. CRITIQUE restores C_full and filters. The two constraint sets are different stores.
records.leak_stop: restore_and_filter is illegal while the relaxed store is live. Filter cannot pop the relaxed bag.
records.idea_count_rule: Count = relax_and_emit at GENERATE_CLOSED, before C_full is restored.

records.mechanical_separator: Counterfactual emits live in an alternate-world namespace (GENERATE). actual_world_score is CRITIQUE against the real-world store.
records.leak_stop: actual_world_score cannot run in GENERATE. Actual-world feasibility is not GENERATE context.
